commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "agent-work"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "89b9518189d2cffe8b18aae8db872d5824f8a115"; test "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}')" = "origin/docs/kobra2-neo-plotter-baseline"

set -euo pipefail; src=''; for p in "$HOME/Downloads/kobra2neo.f3d" "$HOME/Desktop/kobra2neo.f3d" "$HOME/Documents/kobra2neo.f3d"; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then src="$p"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$src" ]; then src=$(find "$HOME/Downloads" "$HOME/Desktop" "$HOME/Documents" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name 'kobra2neo.f3d' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true); fi; if [ -z "$src" ] && command -v mdfind >/dev/null 2>&1; then src=$(mdfind -name kobra2neo.f3d | head -n 1 || true); fi; test -n "$src"; printf 'SOURCE=%s
' "$src"; actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$src" | awk '{print $1}'); printf 'SHA256=%s
' "$actual"; test "$actual" = "bc16edd5d3cf2a7c41ad647d8ffd3002380ad13c0c92f998f67f786b275e85c6"; mkdir -p projects/kobra2-neo/cad/tools/pen; cp "$src" projects/kobra2-neo/cad/tools/pen/kobra2-neo-pen-holder.f3d; printf '%s  %s
' "$actual" 'kobra2-neo-pen-holder.f3d' > projects/kobra2-neo/cad/tools/pen/SOURCE.sha256; test "$(shasum -a 256 projects/kobra2-neo/cad/tools/pen/kobra2-neo-pen-holder.f3d | awk '{print $1}')" = "$actual"
